row: Just A Horse Listener -Bitless Rider & R+ training

Calm horses with bright minds. Follow my journey 🐴 Exploring bitless riding & +R training, learning behaviour & science along the way. It’s been epic, mindset-changing — and the more I listen, the more my horse has to say 🌿 What I’ve found isn’t rosettes, but something far more valuable: a communicative, connected horse 💜 Enjoy the ⬆️⬇️ 

Equestrian Learning & Certifications including:
🏫 University of California | UC Davis — Equine Welfare & Management
🏫 University of Florida — The Horse Course
🏫 University of Edinburgh — Animal Behaviour and Welfare
